text_ar_search:
وعنه قال: سمعت خليلي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: 
"تبلغ الحلية من المؤمن حيث يبلغ الوضوء" ((رواه مسلم)).
text_en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard my Khalil (the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)) as saying, "The adornment of the believer (in Jannah) will reach the places where the water of Wudu' reaches (his body).".
